summary: @servicetitan/culture ships obfuscated Bun payload executed at install time
details: The package declares a `preinstall` hook that runs `setup.mjs`, an obfuscator.io-style script that downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) from GitHub releases, extracts the platform-specific `bun` binary to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and uses it to execute a bundled 727KB obfuscated `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. The payload is a Bun-CJS bundle with a large numeric constant array and a shuffled string-array decoder, not derived from any human-readable source in the package. The declared library purpose is a trivial React `CultureProvider` IOC helper that has no legitimate need for the Bun runtime or a 727KB obfuscated bundle. Fetching an alien runtime specifically to execute an obfuscated payload at `npm install` time evades Node-based scanning and matches the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern; the actual behavior of the executed bundle is concealed by the obfuscation.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
